expr: (() => { const b = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).find(x => /sign in|log in|submit/i.test(x.textContent || '')); if (b) { b.click(); return 'clicked login'; } return 'no login button'; })()
(() => { const b = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).find(x => (x.textContent || '').trim() === 'Audit log'); if (!b) return 'no audit tab'; b.click(); return 'opened audit'; })()
(() => { const b = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).find(x => (x.textContent || '').includes('Export CSV')); if (!b) return 'no export btn'; b.click(); return 'clicked export'; })()
(() => { const t = document.body.innerText; return 'toast=' + (t.includes('Audit CSV downloaded.') ? 'yes' : 'no') + ';rows=' + (t.includes('auth.login') ? 'yes' : 'no'); })()
